name: Alfine Midir
original_name: アルフィーネ・ミディール
source:
"Geez, how mean. Despite everything, I'm still a proper princess, you know?"

Meet Fine, the nickname of Princess Midyr, who's making waves at the magic academy. She's got royal blood running through her veins, with connections in high places - her aunt's the [url=/c135513]Archbishop Mira[/url], and she goes way back with her cousin [url=/c135517]Henrietta[/url] (Mira's daughter). Fine's not just any student; she's the cream of the crop, especially when it comes to healing magic - the royal family's claim to fame.

Growing up in a monastery left her with deep faith, but don't let that fool you. She's mature and graceful one minute, friendly and mischievous the next. As a princess, she's a bit off the beaten path. Her unique take on things earns respect, but keeps people at arm's length. In the end, Fine's admired but hard to pin down - a royal enigma in a class of her own.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.ensemble-game.com/30.kyokumari/character_alfine.html]official website[/url]]
